description: A note without 'used' prints None, as the companion does.

lines: On 2026-09-21, the WhatsApp reminder went out in the older layout, **"None"**, because the newer one, **"project_checkin_v2"**, could not be used: it exists in the language en_US, but WA_TEMPLATE_LANG in .env says en. To check it, run `python -m reminder --whatsapp-template-status` in the second-brain folder.

template_note.why: it exists in the language en_US, but WA_TEMPLATE_LANG in .env says en
